pages.title: Photobioreactor
pages.text: Coils of clear tubing full of green algae, under a bank of lamps, with air bubbling through.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the light and the carbon dioxide. Photosynthesis rises with light as I/(K + I), then bleaches: it must reach 80% of its best. Over 1,800 µmol of light the cells burn.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Algae Culture, Oxygen, Quantum Chlorophyll.
